description:
The acmecorp.test virtual server has a staging directory at /staging/ under its web root (/home/acmecorp/public_html/staging/) that contains a preview of a website redesign. This directory is currently accessible to anyone without authentication.

Your task is to protect the /staging/ directory with HTTP Basic Authentication using Virtualmin's Protected Directories feature (or equivalent manual configuration) so that only authorized users can access the staging preview.

Specifically:
1. Set up HTTP Basic Authentication for the directory /home/acmecorp/public_html/staging/ (URL path: /staging/ on acmecorp.test)
2. Create an authorized user with these credentials:
   - Username: reviewer
   - Password: SecurePreview2024!
3. Ensure the protection is active:
   - Unauthenticated requests to http://acmecorp.test/staging/ should receive a 401 Unauthorized response
   - Requests with the reviewer credentials should receive a 200 OK response and show the staging page content

You may use Virtualmin's web interface (Protected Directories feature) or configure Apache .htaccess/.htpasswd files directly. Both approaches are acceptable.
